title: 3DO DevBench — Memory
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: Status pills
items.text: Run mode (running / paused), guest frame counter and CPU state (running, or HALTED in red at a breakpoint).

items.label: Run controls
items.text: Run (real time), Turbo, Pause, +1 frame / +60, CPU halt (debugger freeze), Reset and Reboot for the selected session.

items.label: Address
items.text: A number, symbol or symbol+offset and a length; ◀ ▶ page through (MCP: emu_read_mem).

items.label: Hex dump
items.text: Hex + ASCII of guest memory (here the code at hud_draw). DRAM 0–0x1FFFFF, VRAM 0x200000+, ROM 0x3000000+.

items.label: Search DRAM
items.text: Find text or hex bytes in DRAM.

items.label: Hits
items.text: Matches with the symbol each falls in (here the "RELIC" strings); click to dump.

items.label: Write
items.text: Write a 32-bit word into guest DRAM/VRAM, e.g. to change a variable while the game runs.
